close_reason: Fixed: use rsplit_once(':') instead of split(':').next() for correct IPv6 literal handling
description: server.rs:361 uses raw_host.split(':').next() to strip the port from the Host header. An IPv6 Host header like '[::1]:443' produces '[' as the domain, never matching any configured domain. RFC 7230 §5.4 specifies IP-literal form '[addr]:port'. Fix: strip brackets and port properly before the domain lookup.
title: mta_sts_handler Host header parsing breaks on IPv6 literal addresses
